_comment: Completeness oracle for ticket 26/08/11/ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSETS-REAL-VOCABULARIES. Every stdio (artifact,standard) pair, its real industry subset vocabulary (beyond the universal ✳️any/'*'), and per-subset spec + hard/soft check briefs. Domain (non-stdio) artifacts are out of scope -- they keep {'*'} only, per binding user decision.

<id>.name: <human name + spec cite>
levels: optional level enum, e.g. PDF/A parts

W4_light: any-only manifest verification for all remaining stdio artifacts

a.schemaGap: PdfSnapshot(1.4) is PageDoc{width,height,text} only -- no object graph; ship a single SOFT 'conformance unverifiable: snapshot lacks object graph' diagnostic until the graph exists
a.composer: inject GTS_PDFA1 OutputIntent, strip encryption/JS/Launch, hard-gate on non-embedded fonts

x.spec: ISO 15930-1:2001 (X-1a) / ISO 15930-3:2002 (X-3), based on PDF 1.4; which one is a 'levels' data value
checks: X-1a mode: HARD no DeviceRGB/CalRGB colorspace names

a.spec: ISO 19005-2:2011 (PDF/A-2) / ISO 19005-3:2012 (PDF/A-3); supersedes the existing ✳️a-2b pilot -- level (2b/2u/3b/3u) becomes analyzer-detected DATA, not the subset id
checks: SOFT font without FontFile/FontFile2/FontFile3 via FontDescriptor (incl DescendantFonts)
A-2 add: HARD embedded-file Filespec objects without /AFRelationship when level data says part=2 (A-3 allows with AFRelationship)
a.composer: strip encryption/JS/Launch, inject GTS_PDFA1 OutputIntent, hard-gate on non-embedded fonts

x.composer: inject GTS_PDFX OutputIntent, add /TrimBox=MediaBox to pages lacking it, strip forbidden action/annot dicts

checks: HARD no /Subtype /Movie or /Subtype /Sound annotations (but /Subtype /3D explicitly ALLOWED -- do not flag)
e.composer: strip encryption/JS/Launch/Movie/Sound, keep 3D annotations, inject OutputIntent

checks: HARD /MarkInfo dict with /Marked true on Catalog
ua.composer: inject /MarkInfo, /Lang, /ViewerPreferences, set info.title; synthesize empty /StructTreeRoot if absent

checks: HARD all X-4 checks (reuse x's conformance fn)
SOFT each DPart node has /DPM metadata dict

h.spec: AIIM/ASTM PDF Healthcare Best Practices Guide (2008) -- industry best-practice, never ISO -- ALL-SOFT profile, no hard checks
checks: SOFT at least one AcroForm /FT /Sig field present
h.composer: populate Info keys, strip JS/Launch; never hard-gates

checks: HARD flag ANY *_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION instance (cc1 allows none)
HARD flag representation types above GEOMETRICALLY_BOUNDED_WIREFRAME_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION rung
HARD flag types above MANIFOLD_SURFACE_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION rung
HARD flag types above FACETED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION rung
HARD flag types above ADVANCED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION rung (i.e. none -- top of ladder)

subsets._ladder: representation subtype -> min CC: none=cc1, GEOMETRICALLY_BOUNDED_WIREFRAME_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION=cc2, GEOMETRICALLY_BOUNDED_SURFACE_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION=cc3, MANIFOLD_SURFACE_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION=cc4, FACETED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION=cc5, ADVANCED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION=cc6
subsets.composer: set file_schema=AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN; hard-gate serialization on instances above the CC's ladder rung

2x3.engineNote: reuse step's Part-21 parser (📐️step/🏅️standards/🔖️ap214/⚙️engine/📐️part21); own Ifc2x3Snapshot type (NOT shared Part21Document identity -- W1 STATUS.md flags shared-type reuse as a banned pattern)

cv20.spec: buildingSMART Coordination View 2.0 MVD (IFC2x3, ISO/PAS 16739:2005 schema)
checks: SOFT exactly one IFCPROJECT with IFCUNITASSIGNMENT
SOFT every geometry-bearing IFCPRODUCT references an IFCLOCALPLACEMENT
cv20.composer: write CV2.0 descriptor, strip/refuse structural entities

checks: SOFT structural members/connections related via IFCRELASSIGNSTOGROUP
sav.composer: write descriptor, refuse when no analysis model exists

cobie.spec: buildingSMART Basic FM Handover MVD (IFC2x3, carries COBie 2.4)
checks: SOFT every IFCSPACE has non-empty Name
SOFT IFC*TYPE + IFCRELDEFINESBYTYPE present for maintainable products
cobie.composer: write descriptor, inject missing storey/space names

rv.composer: write ReferenceView_V1.2 descriptor, hard-gate on advanced-B-Rep presence

dtv.spec: buildingSMART IFC4 Design Transfer View MVD (DTV 1.1)
checks: advanced B-Rep explicitly ALLOWED -- do not flag
SOFT IFCRELVOIDSELEMENT openings resolve to existing instance ids
dtv.composer: write DTV descriptor, no geometry gate

tiny.spec: W3C Mobile SVG Profiles REC-SVGMobile-20030114 §SVG Tiny 1.1
checks: SOFT no xlink:href to external documents
tiny.composer: set baseProfile/version, hard-gate on blocklisted elements/attrs

checks: HARD clip-path referencing a clipPath containing text descendants
basic.composer: set root attrs, hard-gate on blocklisted filter primitives

subsets._pattern: shared ecma-376 conformance-class pattern, see s.stdio.xlsx/s.stdio.pptx for same shape

checks: HARD main document part bytes declare strict main ns
HARD no part bytes contain transitional main ns or VML ns
HARD all opc.relationships use strict relationship base
strict.composer: write strict namespace set + relationship bases; hard-gate on VML content

checks: HARD main part declares transitional main ns
transitional.composer: write transitional namespace set + relationship bases

strict.checks: same pattern as docx strict, workbook@conformance attribute

i-json.spec: RFC 7493 I-JSON Message Format (profile of RFC 8259)
checks: HARD duplicate member names within any object (recursive)
HARD numbers not exactly representable as IEEE-754 double (|n|>2^53-1 for integers)
SOFT top-level value is object or array
SOFT strings containing Unicode noncharacters U+FFFE/U+FFFF/U+FDD0-U+FDEF
i-json.composer: hard-gate on duplicate keys, no injection needed
i-json.crossTicketDependency: json ✳️any's diff/mutations component.rs currently fails to compile (protocol::DiffAlgebra import) due to another session's in-flight DiffAlgebra relocation -- see baseline-cargo-w0.txt note; i-json inherits this until that session lands its fix

iso21320.spec: ISO/IEC 21320-1:2015 Document Container File Part 1 Core
checks: HARD flags bit6/bit13 (strong encryption/masked headers) forbidden
SOFT flags bit3 (data descriptor) interop warning
iso21320.composer: clear forbidden flag bits, always Stored/Deflate, version_needed<=20
iso21320.schemaGap: split/spanned-archive disk-number fields not retained -- note gap, skip that check

checks: HARD doctype's declared root name equals actual root element name
SOFT standalone=true while doctype references external subset (suspicious)
SOFT advisory: validity-not-fully-verified (doctype internal subset unparsed, no DTD content-model validator)
valid.schemaGap: doctype retained as raw String; full DTD element/attlist validation out of scope

checks: HARD Compression in {1 none,2 CCITT G3-1D,32773 PackBits}
HARD strip-organized (StripOffsets/StripByteCounts present, no Tile* tags)
baseline.schemaGap: BLOCKING -- TiffSnapshot retains only decoded RasterImage{width,height,rgba}, no IFD; needs ifds:Vec<TiffIfdEntry> + compression/photometric retained by engine before real checks; until landed emit single SOFT 'unverifiable: snapshot lacks IFD' diagnostic

baseline.spec: ITU-T T.81 / ISO 10918-1 baseline sequential DCT (Annex F) in JFIF 1.01 container
checks: HARD frame marker SOF0 only (no SOF2/9/10/11)
baseline.composer: conforming by construction (always SOF0/8-bit/Huffman) -- assert via shared check once fields exist
baseline.schemaGap: BLOCKING -- JpgSnapshot retains only image:RasterImage; JpgFrameHeader/JpgScanComponent already defined in schema file but not snapshot fields; add frame,sof_marker,arithmetic; until landed emit single SOFT unverifiable diagnostic

anyOnlyArtifacts._justification_pattern: no industry-defined conformance profile/class/MVD exists; extensions (GFM, APNG, KHR_* glTF extensions) are supersets not restrictive subsets; serializations (GLB) are not subsets
